Sorry, Not Sorry: An Afternoon at Sorry Sugar

I have, over the years, developed a healthy suspicion of any establishment that apologises in its own name. "Sorry" is not a word I associate with good coffee, and yet here I was, on the Lower Ground Floor of M3M 65th Avenue in Sector 65, Gurugram, walking into a café that has built its entire identity around an apology to sugar. By the time I left, I understood why.

Sorry Sugar bills itself as India's first sweetest sugarless coffee brand, which is the sort of claim that usually makes me reach for my scepticism along with my cup. We have all sat through enough "guilt-free" menus dressed up in stevia and disappointment to know that sugar substitutes and genuine flavour rarely arrive at the table together. But Kunal Verma, who co-founded the place, has clearly thought this through rather more carefully than most.

The trick, it turns out, lies in monk fruit — a sweetener I confess I knew more about in theory than in practice. Unlike the sugar alternatives that leave an unfortunate metallic aftertaste loitering on the palate, monk fruit does its job with a surprising honesty. There is no spike, no crash, none of that jittery sweetness-then-slump one associates with a sugar-laden frappe on a Tuesday afternoon. It simply tastes like something you'd order for pleasure, not penance.

I began, naturally, with the Sea Salt Caramel Frappe, which I gather is something of a house favourite, and it is easy to see why. The pre-biotic cold brew base — served, rather charmingly, in its own little glass bottle — has a clean, gut-friendly conscience about it that somehow doesn't get in the way of the caramel doing its work. I followed this with the Rich Chocolate Mocha, which had enough depth to satisfy a chocolate purist, and a French Vanilla that I'd happily recommend to anyone who thinks sugar-free automatically means flavour-free. The Hazel Almond, for what it's worth, rounded out the quartet rather elegantly.

On the food side, the Blueberry Cheesecake earns its reputation as the top-seller without much argument from me — it has that rare quality of tasting indulgent while behaving itself nutritionally.

☕✨ SORRY SUGAR Where Every Sip Feels Like a Guilt-Free Treat! 💖

If you’re looking for a café that serves delicious beverages without compromising on taste, Sorry Sugar. is a must-visit! From refreshing drinks to wholesome treats, every sip is crafted to satisfy your cravings while keeping it light and enjoyable. The chic interiors, vibrant vibes, and Instagram-worthy corners make it the perfect place to relax, click stunning pictures, and spend quality time with friends.

Whether you’re a coffee lover, a smoothie enthusiast, or simply looking for your next favorite café, this place deserves a spot on your list. Great taste, beautiful ambience and an experience you’ll want to come back for again and again.

📍 Location: Sorry Sugar Coffee Café, M3M Avenue, Gurgaon
